This page lists the complete vocabulary of this manual, read from
[`docs/glossary.yml`](https://github.com/brenobeirigo/quarto-glossary/blob/main/docs/glossary.yml).
The project sets `html-glossary-page: glossary.qmd`, so a reference on any
page without its own list links to an entry here.

The placeholder below uses `include-unused="true"` to print every entry,
whether or not this page cites it:

```markdown
::: {.glossary include-unused="true" title="Terms"}
:::
```

::: {.glossary include-unused="true" title="Terms"}
:::
